question: After the i18n generated-output blocker is fixed, should PR #97145 be the canonical landing path for issue #97069 over open duplicate PRs #97077, #97081, #97345, #98108, and #98215?
rationale: The code path is a narrow plausible fix with real Telegram proof, but multiple open contributor PRs overlap the same bug and a maintainer should choose the canonical branch before closing siblings.

options.title: Adopt #97145 after i18n sync

options.title: Choose a broader duplicate

options.title: Pause the cluster
